faculty_decisions.FD-NR-01: Manual norepinephrine rate-control semantics are accepted for DEVELOPMENT. Supported explicit operations: START, INCREASE, DECREASE, STOP, RESTART, using absolute rates in mcg/min.
faculty_decisions.FD-NR-02: Close further calibration of tone_gain, half_effect_rate_mcg_min, onset_tau_min and offset_tau_min for this manual-rate-control capability. Do NOT reopen LOW, HIGH, the CENTER_REFERENCE selection or the common-tone calibration.
faculty_decisions.FD-NR-03: Create a durable development status NOREPINEPHRINE_MANUAL_RATE_CONTROL_DEVELOPMENT_SEMANTICS_CLOSED: accepted for development semantics. It does NOT mean clinical validation, production approval, resident approval or live authority expansion.
faculty_decisions.FD-NR-04: Current unsupported domains remain: mcg/kg/min; automatic MAP-target titration; relative commands without a supported active-rate context; consciousness under tone; pump-limited educational promotion. None is implemented in this cycle.
faculty_decisions.FD-NR-05: The next safety-critical issue is the inherited parsing defect: 'titrate norepinephrine to MAP 65' may be interpreted as 65 mcg/min. It must be reproduced, traced and fixed before any attempt to make shadow consume engine-resolved orders.
faculty_decisions.FD-NR-06: No norepinephrine authority expansion is authorized. Current live authority scope remains unchanged.
faculty_decisions.FD-NR-07: Current malformed-order behavior remains provisionally FAIL CLOSED. Recovery semantics are not changed in this package unless needed to repair a demonstrated safety defect; a later explicit valid order recovering from a malformed-order boundary is a separate faculty decision.

is_not: an approval of norepinephrine in any patient

ratified: MANUAL NOREPINEPHRINE RATE CONTROL (explicit absolute rates in mcg/min, through the common vasoconstrictor-support writer, in the development shadow)

unsupported_domains.AUTOMATIC_MAP_TARGET_TITRATION: no rate is ever chosen from a pressure; there is no controller and no closed loop
unsupported_domains.MCG_PER_KG_PER_MIN: a weight-based dose is never converted to an absolute rate
unsupported_domains.RELATIVE_COMMAND_WITHOUT_A_SUPPORTED_ACT: 'increase norepinephrine' with no absolute rate and no running infusion is not guessed
